name: save-boot-21a-talk-rule-talker
description: #237 acceptance (attempt 3). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mds7st1.json (field 144) and load. Hold Down 300 frames (save-boot-19a's route, where Circle opens window 1) and stop before Circle. Checks that model 7 is within talk range (ground distance < TalkRange + the player's SolidRange, n7 -1), its TalkOff reads 0, its height is within 256 field units of the player's (h7: field units, range plus 256), models 8 and 9 (TalkOff 0 per attempt 1) are outside, the player is model 0 and its own TalkOff reads 0, and that a rerun matches.
